pins.definition: Of a person: nervous or uncomfortable around other people.
Nervous, quiet, or lacking confidence around other people.
Nervous or uncomfortable with other people, especially strangers.

situation: A young woman stands slightly turned away from a group of lively guests at a party, pressing her back flat against a living room wall.
subject: nervous isolation among people
brief: A young woman presses her back tightly against a living room wall, shoulders hunched and fingers tightly interlaced in front of her. Across the softly lit room, a blurred cluster of party guests laugh and gesture animatedly, entirely turned toward one another while she remains alone in the deep shadow at the edge of the frame.
